_doc: Physical chess boards per world. seatA/seatB are the two stand cells; standing on a free seat offers/joins a game (server chess.ts). `npc` names a resident opponent whose placed NPC stands on seatB — the board then plays you itself. Overridable per-world without a deploy via live/tuning/chess.json {worlds:{<world>:[...]}} — same shape, live wins.
